Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate, for the 
applicant.
Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder, for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Rakesh Negi, Advocate, for the 
respondent. 
IA Nos.10681 of 2022 and 10682 of 
2022, would stand allowed. The respective 
counter affidavit and rejoinder affidavit are 
taken on record. 
The order-sheet reflects, that there was a 
probability of the settlement between the 
parties, and hence the parties were called upon 
to be present vide orders dated 04.11.2019 and 
21.11.2019, but today the respondent’s counsel 
has made a statement, that there is no 
possibility of the settlement between the 
parties. Hence, the C482 application has to be 
decided on its own merit.
As of now the pleadings have been 
exchanged. Hence, the C482 application is 
directed to be listed in the week commencing 
10.04.2023, for hearing at an admission 
stage/final disposal.
Interim order dated 24.09.2019, would 
remain extended till the next date of listing. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 31.03.2023
